summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement for a private placement of ~6.72M shares at $68.73/share and ~6.37M pre-funded warrants at $68.2799/warrant, raising ~$900M in gross proceeds. The funds will support a strategic compute collaboration with NVIDIA. The pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.0001/share, with ownership caps of 9.99% (rising to 19.99% after HSR clearance and 100% after stockholder approval). Closing expected June 22, 2026. This is a conventional equity financing, not a special-situation event; there is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or corporate action that alters control or capital structure in a transformative manner.
